entities.name: Sally St. Clair
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sally St. Clair or St. Clare was an American woman from South Carolina who disguised herself as a man and joined the Continental Army. Her true gender was not discovered by her fellow soldiers until after she was killed in battle during the Siege of Savannah in 1782.
